description: This file defines the PresentationMessageMap class, a custom implementation of Java's Map interface, which manages a collection of PresentationMessage objects all constrained to the same locale.

classes.name: PresentationMessageMap
classes.description: A specialized Map implementation that wraps a HashMap to store PresentationMessage objects, ensuring all messages are in a specified locale.

methods.name: PresentationMessageMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing the map with a specific Locale.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all entries from the map.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the map.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the map.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a set view of the map's entries.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns the set of keys in the map.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the map if the value's locale matches the map's locale.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Adds all entries from another map, filtering out messages with non-matching locales.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the entry associated with a given key.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the map.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a collection of all values in the map.
